scripts.text: You are carrying too many items, please reduce it and come back again!
scripts.translation: 你攜帶的物品太多了，請減少一些再來！

scripts.text: You are over the weight limit, please reduce it and come back again!
scripts.translation: 你超過了負重上限，請減少一些再來！

scripts.text:
[Devil Enchant Master]
Yes?
You are looking for me?
scripts.translation:
[惡魔附魔大師]
有什麼事？
你是來找我的嗎？

scripts.text: This is the first time seeing you!
scripts.translation: 第一次見到你！

scripts.text: I heard that you are the best!
scripts.translation: 聽說你是最厲害的！

scripts.text: Please initialize the enchant.
scripts.translation: 請重置附魔。

scripts.text:
[Devil Enchant Master]
Ha ha ha~ Of course, I am not the kind of person that simply deals with people.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔附魔大師]
哈哈~ 當然，我可不是那種隨便就會幫人辦事的人。

scripts.text:
[Devil Enchant Master]
Including you! Even if you offer me plenty of money, I will not simply enchant for you!!
scripts.translation:
[惡魔附魔大師]
包括你！就算你給我很多錢，我也不會隨便幫你附魔！！

scripts.text:
[Devil Enchant Master]
Have you seen my title? Very few people have this title for a reason!
scripts.translation:
[惡魔附魔大師]
你看到我的頭銜了嗎？很少有人擁有這個頭銜，是有原因的！

scripts.text:
[Devil Enchant Master]
I will only enchant if you bring an ^0000ffEnchant Book^000000 along!
scripts.translation:
[惡魔附魔大師]
只有你帶著^0000ff附魔書^000000來，我才會幫你附魔！

scripts.text:
[Devil Enchant Master]
Else, I will not enchant for you....
scripts.translation:
[惡魔附魔大師]
否則，我是不會幫你附魔的...

scripts.text:
[Devil Enchant Master]
Are you listening to me? I will only do for you if you bring the Enchant Book!
scripts.translation:
[惡魔附魔大師]
你聽清楚了嗎？只有你帶著附魔書來，我才會幫你！

scripts.text:
[Devil Enchant Master]
Initializing will cost 100,000 zeny. It seems you do not have enough zeny...
scripts.translation:
[惡魔附魔大師]
重置附魔需要100,000 Zeny。看來你的Zeny不夠...

scripts.text:
[Devil Enchant Master]
Initializing will cost 100,000 zeny and confirming whether the weapon is enchanted!
scripts.translation:
[惡魔附魔大師]
重置附魔需要100,000 Zeny，並確認武器是否已附魔！

scripts.text: Let me think about it.
scripts.translation: 讓我考慮一下。

scripts.text: Initialize it now!
scripts.translation: 現在就重置！

scripts.text:
[Devil Enchant Master]
Come back after you have confirmed!
scripts.translation:
[惡魔附魔大師]
確認後再回來！

scripts.text:
[Devil Enchant Master]
Are you trying to remove the enchanted equipment?
scripts.translation:
[惡魔附魔大師]
你是想移除附魔裝備嗎？

scripts.text:
[Devil Enchant Master]
I don't want to touch your equipment now!
scripts.translation:
[惡魔附魔大師]
我現在不想碰你的裝備！

scripts.text:
[Devil Enchant Master]
Are you listening to me? I will only do for you if you bring the Enchant Book!
scripts.translation:
[惡魔附魔大師]
你聽清楚了嗎？只有你帶著附魔書來，我才會幫你！

scripts.text:
[Devil Enchant Master]
Which type of effect do you want to enchant?
scripts.translation:
[惡魔附魔大師]
你想附魔哪種效果？

scripts.text:
[Devil Enchant Master]
You need to bring some money to initialize!!
scripts.translation:
[惡魔附魔大師]
重置附魔需要帶錢來！！

scripts.text:
[Devil Enchant Master]
This item is not enchanted!
scripts.translation:
[惡魔附魔大師]
這件物品還沒有附魔！

scripts.text:
[Devil Enchant Master]
Are you unequipping now?
scripts.translation:
[惡魔附魔大師]
你是要解除裝備嗎？

scripts.text:
[Devil Enchant Master]
I initialized the enchant effects.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔附魔大師]
我已經重置了附魔效果。

scripts.text:
[Devil Enchant Master]
It seems you have chosen the wrong job??
scripts.translation:
[惡魔附魔大師]
看來你選錯了職業？

scripts.text: Let me think about it.
scripts.translation: 讓我考慮一下。

scripts.text: Physical Series
scripts.translation: 物理系

scripts.text: Magical Series
scripts.translation: 魔法系

scripts.text:
[Devil Enchant Master]
Come back again after you change your mind!
scripts.translation:
[惡魔附魔大師]
想好了再來找我！

scripts.text:
[Devil Enchant Master]
This equipment has been enchanted! You need to initialize first before you want to enchant it again.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔附魔大師]
這件裝備已經附魔了！如果你想重新附魔，需要先重置。

scripts.text:
[Devil Enchant Master]
The enchant process might fail, and ^ff0000it will reduce partial refine level^000000, but the slotted card and weapon will not be broken! Are you sure you want to continue?
scripts.translation:
[惡魔附魔大師]
附魔過程可能會失敗，並且^ff0000會降低部分強化等級^000000，但鑲嵌的卡片和武器本身不會損壞！你確定要繼續嗎？

scripts.text: Next time!
scripts.translation: 下次吧！

scripts.text: Start now!
scripts.translation: 現在開始！

scripts.text:
[Devil Enchant Master]
Come back again after you have decided!
scripts.translation:
[惡魔附魔大師]
決定了再來找我！

scripts.text:
[Devil Enchant Master]
It seems there's a problem, let me take a look.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔附魔大師]
看起來有點問題，讓我檢查一下。

scripts.text:
[Devil Enchant Master]
Hmm! This item is having a problem, please check it again!
scripts.translation:
[惡魔附魔大師]
嗯！這件物品有問題，請再檢查一下！

scripts.text:
[Devil Enchant Master]
This item has been enchanted!
scripts.translation:
[惡魔附魔大師]
這件物品已經附魔了！

scripts.text:
[Devil Enchant Master]
Are you listening to me? I will only do for you if you bring the Enchant Book!
scripts.translation:
[惡魔附魔大師]
你聽清楚了嗎？只有你帶著附魔書來，我才會幫你！

scripts.text:
[Devil Enchant Master]
Oh! Unbelievable!! It failed!! Please come again!
scripts.translation:
[惡魔附魔大師]
噢！難以置信！！失敗了！！請再來一次！

scripts.text:
[Devil Enchant Master]
The slot ^9900004^000000 has been enchanted!
scripts.translation:
[惡魔附魔大師]
^9900004^000000號槽位已經附魔了！

scripts.text:
[Devil Enchant Master]
The failure has reduced the refine by {0}! Don't be depressed!
scripts.translation:
[惡魔附魔大師]
失敗導致強化等級降低了{0}！別灰心！
